title.rendered: City Forest Lodge – Forest Hill – Bar Mitzvah – San Francisco

content.rendered:
December 21st 2013

Songs:

1 Memories
2. Forever young granparents
3. uncles its a family affair
4 cousins Born to be wild
5 fuzins what i like about you
6. old friends bad boys bob marley
7. or shalom friends we go togethern
8. Rooftop friends we go together/wild thing
nate
9. nanny do you believe in magiv
10 Brother Nate Superman Theme
11. Karen your mama dont dance
12. Bob and Inga , do “only wanna be with you” by Hootie and the Blowfish

13 Ben Me myself and I
14 Good luck to all good luck- luck be a lady

I would like to celebrate and honor some of the people that have made my life and the life of my parents special. As I call you, please come up and help me light a candle.

1. First I would like to light a candle for those that are no longer here with us, like my grandfather on my father’s side, Max Tesler and all other people that were dear to us and will be missed. 1 Memories
2. Next, I would like to invite the wise owls of the group. My grandma Sue, Nana Nancy Tesler, Jerry Adler and Maria Veksler. A special thanks to Jerry for the tallit he passed on to me, as my Dad could not be bothered to get me a new one (just kidding) it was incredibly meaningful, and to Maria for coming out here all the way from New York. 2. Forever young
3. A special thanks to all of my aunts and uncles — Uncle Ken, Uncle Doug and Aunt Leslie (whom I used to call Duncle Ug and Aunt ZeeZee for some reason), Auntie Ann and also Allen and Lola. Thanks so much to both my Uncle Ken for traveling all the way from New York and to Uncle Doug and Aunt Leslie for coming out to celebrate with me from Colorado. Although they were probably just runnig away from their local bad weather and using my Bar Mitzvah as an excuse to come to sunny California. 3 its a family affair
4. Next, I would like to invite up all of my cousins: Melanie, Jake, Julia Rose, Noah, Gabby, Tucker and McKenzie. 4 Born to be wild
5. You saw my fake Uncles and Aunts, also known as my Funcles and Fants during my Bar Mitzvah ceremony. I call them fake uncles and fake aunts now because for the longest time, I had no idea I was not related to them! It was only a couple of years ago that I finally realized that Grace was NOT my actual cousin. You saw enough of them during the service, so, now I would like to invite up their offspring, also known as my fake cousins or “fuzins:” Zoe and Maddy, Sophie and Ella, Grace and Sarah, Sierra, Devon and Brody. Just as my funcles and fants play an important part in my life, all my fuzins ROCK!! They make up my extended family and I feel very lucky to get to see them so often. 5 what i like about you
6. I am especially lucky to still be friends with some guys I have known since I was in pre-school at Eureka Learning Center about a million years ago. So, next, I would like to invite up my oldest buddies, Avery and Hudson, who are still fun to get into trouble with…6 bad boys bob marley
7. Avery, you can stay up here because next I’d like to ask my Or Shalom classmates, who made studying ALMOST fun, to come up and help light a candle. 8 we go togethe
8. Olive, you can stay up here because next I’d like to invite my Rooftop pals Kiran, Sebe, Felix, Jared, Gabriel, and Olive. 9. wild thing
9. Now, I would like to invite up someone to represent all my teachers, tutors and caregivers – my nanny Nan, who takes care of me after school and gets to see the dark side of me that not everyone wants to see – the grumpy after-school Ben who doesn’t want to do his homework and who isn’t at all friendly until he’s had at least three bean and cheese tacos! 10 Do you believe in magic
10. Batman has the Joker. Superman has Lex Luthor. Everyone needs a nemesis. At the risk of burning the place down, I’d like to invite my best friend/nemesis — my brother Nate to come light a candle. Just one Nate.11 Superman theme
11. My mom Karen. 12 your mama dont dance
12. My dad Bob and Inga. [fill in what you’d like to say about Dad and Inga] 12 only wanna be with you” by Hootie and the Blowfish
13. Now, I’d like to invite myself! 13 me myself and I de la sol
14. Good luck to all candle 14 luck be a lady
